when.test: scope == null or scope.purchaserScope.empty or scope.warehouseScope.empty

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order so WHERE so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so.settlement_total_amount), 0) FROM sales_order so WHERE so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE c.deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = FALSE

SELECT item.product_name_snapshot AS name, COALESCE(SUM(item.settlement_line_amount), 0) AS amount FROM sales_order_item item JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = item.order_id WHERE item.deleted = FALSE AND so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND so.created_at >= #{startTime} AND so.created_at < #{endTime}
GROUP BY item.spu_id, item.product_name_snapshot ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) FROM inventory_balance b WHERE b.deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.sku_id) FROM inventory_balance b WHERE b.deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse w WHERE w.deleted = FALSE AND w.status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT w.name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM inventory_balance b JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id WHERE b.deleted = FALSE AND w.deleted = FALSE
GROUP BY b.warehouse_id, w.name ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT (b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity) AS availableQuantity, t.warn_min AS warnMin, t.warn_max AS warnMax FROM inventory_warning_threshold t LEFT JOIN inventory_balance b ON b.warehouse_id = t.warehouse_id AND b.sku_id = t.sku_id AND b.deleted = FALSE WHERE t.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL SELECT (b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity) AS availableQuantity, CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS warnMin, CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS warnMax FROM inventory_balance b WHERE b.deleted = FALSE
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_warning_threshold t WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id AND t.sku_id = b.sku_id )

SELECT w.name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.quantity) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND m.warehouse_id = w.id AND m.movement_type IN #{mt} AND m.occurred_at >= #{startTime} AND m.occurred_at < #{endTime}), 0) AS todayOutboundQuantity FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inventory_balance b ON b.warehouse_id = w.id AND b.deleted = FALSE WHERE w.deleted = FALSE AND w.status = 'ENABLED'
GROUP BY w.id, w.name ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, to_char(d, 'MM-DD') AS label, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order so WHERE so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date ), 0) AS orders, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(so.settlement_total_amount) FROM sales_order so WHERE so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date ), 0) AS sales, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.deleted = FALSE AND (po.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date ), 0) AS purchaseOrders, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.total_amount) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.deleted = FALSE AND (po.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date ), 0) AS purchaseAmounts, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type IN #{mt} THEN m.quantity ELSE -m.quantity END) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND (m.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date <= d::date ), 0) AS inventoryQuantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.quantity) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND m.movement_type IN #{mt} AND (m.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date ), 0) AS inboundQuantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.quantity) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND m.movement_type IN #{mt} AND (m.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date ), 0) AS outboundQuantity FROM generate_series(#{startDate}::date, #{endDate}::date, INTERVAL '1 day') AS gs(d) ORDER BY d
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.deleted = FALSE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(po.total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.deleted = FALSE
mapper.sql: SELECT c.city_code IS NOT NULL AS located, c.city_code AS city_code FROM customer c WHERE c.deleted = FALSE
SELECT s.city_code IS NOT NULL AS located, s.city_code AS city_code FROM supplier s WHERE s.deleted = FALSE
SELECT w.city_code IS NOT NULL AS located, w.city_code AS city_code FROM warehouse w WHERE w.deleted = FALSE AND w.status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.select: SELECT city.region_code AS cityCode, city.region_name AS cityName, city.parent_code AS provinceCode, province.region_name AS provinceName, city.center_lng AS centerLng, city.center_lat AS centerLat, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE src.kind = 'CUSTOMER') AS customerCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE src.kind = 'SUPPLIER') AS supplierCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE src.kind = 'WAREHOUSE') AS warehouseCount FROM ( SELECT city_code, 'CUSTOMER'::text AS kind FROM () t WHERE t.located UNION ALL SELECT city_code, 'SUPPLIER'::text FROM () t WHERE t.located UNION ALL SELECT city_code, 'WAREHOUSE'::text FROM () t WHERE t.located ) src JOIN scm_region city ON city.deleted = FALSE AND city.region_level = 2 AND city.region_code = src.city_code JOIN scm_region province ON province.deleted = FALSE AND province.region_level = 1 AND province.region_code = city.parent_code GROUP BY city.region_code, city.region_name, city.parent_code, province.region_name, city.center_lng, city.center_lat ORDER BY customerCount DESC, cityCode

SELECT c.total AS customerTotal, c.located AS customerLocated, s.total AS supplierTotal, s.located AS supplierLocated, w.total AS warehouseTotal, w.located AS warehouseLocated FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE located) AS located FROM () t) c CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE located) AS located FROM () t) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE located) AS located FROM () t) w
